entities.title: Static page files
entities.summary: The files build.mjs copies beside the export: the headers, the loading screen's styles and the icon.
entities.purpose: _headers sets the Content-Security-Policy and the other security headers for every static file; shell.css styles the page and its loading screen; favicon.svg is the tab's icon.
boundaries: The Worker sets its own headers on the responses it makes (the page, the API, the joined index.wasm); _headers covers the static assets Cloudflare serves.
